## Customer Engagement

```{r completed_qbrs, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
  align_table <- c('l', 'r')
  
  recent_qbrs=op_list$accounts %>%
    arrange(`Date of last EBR`) %>%
    select(`Account Name`,`Date of last EBR`) %>%
    filter(as.Date(`Date of last EBR`)>=(Sys.Date()-14))
  
  cat("### QBRs Delivered in the past 14 days\n\n")
  print(kable(recent_qbrs, align=align_table))
  cat("\n---\n") # Separator for clarity
  
```

```{r upcoming_qbrs, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
  align_table <- c('l', 'r')
  
  upcoming_qbrs=op_list$accounts %>%
    arrange(`Date of next EBR`) %>%
    select(`Account Name`,`Date of next EBR`) %>%
    filter(as.Date(`Date of next EBR`)<=(Sys.Date()+14))

  cat("### Upcoming QBRs in the next 14 days\n\n")
  print(kable(upcoming_qbrs, align=align_table))
  cat("\n---\n") # Separator for clarity
  
```
